column3: Saori Route ・ Plan Execution Report
Saori. I understand how you feel.
Kyousuke-shi?
Now that it's come to this, I no longer care about appearances. I'll have you cancel this engagement.
C-C-Cancel the engagement?
Exactly. That's an easy thing to do!
You won't give up on being an otaku, and you won't have to marry.
You'll be killing two birds with one stone.
However it's not, it's not something that I can do!
Why are you wavering about that?!
Don't just decide by yourself whether you can do it or not!
It's strange, when you're the one saying it, it feels like I can do it...
But... But!
You say so, but Saori-
NOWAYNOWAYNOWAYNOWAY! It's totally impossible!
Kyousuke-shi doesn't realize the gravity of the situation!
You don't have to refute that so frantically!
Kyousuke-shi does not understand!
The weight behind an engagement's cancellation... Thou hath no idea whatsoever of the implications!
Cancelling the engagement? It means writing off the marriage.
It's not... That's not it, Kyousuke-shi...
It's not such a simple matter...
Saori...
It doth not concern me only.
Since it implicate both families, it is not something I can do on my own accord.
I-I guess so...
Even if I cannot say that what you're saying hasn't crossed my mind...
However, it isn't a world where a single girl can act selfishly and get away with it...
That's why, consider that all this talk about an engagement cancellation hasn't happened.
I see, she endured quite a bit by herself.
And I made mockery of it with my words... Gah, dammit, I failed...!
That's right... She lengthily considered it, and accepted this marriage.
It probably was difficult for her to talk about it to me, an outsider.
Kyousuke-shi? Are you listening?
Ah, yeah... Of course.
I know just how grave an engagement cancellation is. It implicates both families after all.
Oooh! As expected from Kyousuke-shi!
That you understand this much about me...! How is it that I failed to be aware of this?
You had me frightened for a moment here.
But you see, could you try to listen to me with a clear mind?
In response to the advice I provided, you said stuff like "It's impossible" or "It's useless", right?
Why did you decide to do so right from the start?
That's...
By refusing suggestions, you cannot follow advice, nor resolve your troubles.
What is it that you want to me to say, Saori?
Nothing will happen if you keep crushing possibilities. Let's try something before deciding that it's impossible!
But the present situation is...
If I were to compare this situation to a game of shogi, it would be "Checkmate".
What's a checkmate! If you're afraid of being in a dead end, then turn it around!
S-Such outrageous disregard for personal property!
However, this isn't fair, you know?
This isn't a situation that calls for fair play!
Doing so while screaming, it is no different than a child's tantrum!
Hgnn! That may be the case but...!
Damn... Don't I have something up my sleeve?
It's fine, Kyousuke-shi. After all this, I have made my resolution.
I selfishly over thought this, it was my mistake to unreasonably press my concerns on Kyousuke-shi.
A mistake...? Don't say things like that!
Thank you very much. Simply hearing those words is enough to tighten my heart over the fact that I have such a good friend.
However, all I did was cause you trouble.
That's why, it's enough.
The one who should think clearly is Kyousuke-shi!
What?
When you act so rashly, any form of rational thinking is gone!
Anyway, how about taking a break to eat some shaved ice? I'll treat you, so-
Saori! Don't pretend to be a "nice" person!
Wha...! That's very rude of you to say that!
Shut up, damn it! Being a "nice" person, is the first step to being a nobody!
I don't want you to act like a "nice" person that people only hang out with for their own benefit.
*giggle*! What's with that messed up theory?
Messed up or not, I want to argue my belief that there IS a possibility.
Seriously... That's why Kyousuke-shi is...
Shaved ice, huh...
They're awesome in this season! You stuff your mouth with flakes of ice-
And get a brain-freeze, and turn your tongue into the color of the syrup?
Right right! You're enjoying yourself just thinking about it!
So, let's bring this gloomy talk to a close, and get some shaved ice with me-
No, I won't bring it to a close.
Anyway, let's have a parting ceremony...
When the time comes, I'd like you to take a seat as an attendee.
I don't need a seat!
Kyo-Kyousuke-shi!?
I refuse to accept something like a parting ceremony either! You might make arrangements to have a seat for me, but I won't take it.
I'm begging you, don't say something like "separation" so easily...
Ah...
I don't know if there's a best way or not, but I have thoughts on this.
So please, listen to what I have to say.
So, that's how it is...
It's nooooooot!!!
Hiiiiiiiii?! Kyousuke-shi! You're very loud!
Like I can take that without shouting! Stupid!
Abducting this pure and innocent maiden and calling her stupid is very cruel!
Shut up! You're stupid, so I'll call you stupid!
